Build the grouped G matrix for the NFDS model

build_gnfds.Rd

Groups the isolate gene presence/absence matrix by model group, computes locus frequencies per year from x(t), computes several locus stability statistics, keeps intermediate-frequency loci and orders them by logitdiff.

Usage

build_gnfds(
  G,
  meta_clean,
  xt,
  pre_years,
  post_years,
  all_years,
  min_freq = 0.05,
  max_freq = 0.95
)

Arguments

G

Raw presence/absence matrix, one row per isolate (row names are sample accessions), one column per locus.

meta_clean

Metadata with a group column, e.g. reweight_carriage()$meta_clean_groups.

xt

Grouped x(t), e.g. from reweight_carriage_uncertainty().

pre_years

Pre-vaccine years (the "pre2009" frequency).

post_years

Post-vaccine years (the "post2011" frequency).

all_years

All years used for the year-to-year variance.

min_freq, max_freq

Loci with a pre-vaccine frequency outside this range are left out of the model.

Value

A list with G (the grouped, filtered and ordered G for the NFDS model) and locus_by_year (locus frequencies per year and the statistics, with an in_model column).
